title: Maximum Score of a Split
summary: Split nums into a nonempty prefix and nonempty suffix. Score the split as the prefix total minus the smallest suffix value. Return the greatest score among all split positions.
officialConstraints: Array length 2 through 100000; integer values from -1000000000 through 1000000000.
pitfalls: The suffix contribution is its minimum, not its sum. Negative answers are valid. Totals may exceed 32-bit range.
